goals: Estimation of native field main effects under calendar simulation
Detection and quantified control of teammate, opponent and team-level interference
Mapping outcome evidence into VAE, not direct unreviewed AI self-tuning

design_units.player: player within team and game, dependent teammates

arm_worldlines.writes: only approved independently verified player fields
only separately approved and live-verified coach field actions

player_screen_capacity_example.interpretation: screening coverage only; eligibility, position and interference reduce field coverage

coach_screen_capacity_example.interpretation: screening only; 1-2 fields per round for confirmation, at most 30 independent coach units per worldline

preconditions: Host P0 fixes completed and verified before any live setter
Player/coaching controls not mixed except planned interaction
No changes made before explicit user approval of each complete batch plan digest

gates.name: Inventory and native write qualification
gates.accept: named/unnamed and data/setting distinctions maintained, live writer never inferred

gates.name: Eligible pool and baseline
gates.accept: opportunity, minutes and roster eligibility from WorldData

gates.name: Worldline clone reproducibility
gates.accept: save/data/game dates independent, repeat no-change calendar sim to quantify noise

gates.name: Constrained stratified randomization
gates.accept: reproducible random seed, matched controls, bounded within-team interference

gates.name: Exact planned action list
gates.accept: Human approves per worldline+batch+field+objects+target before native edits

gates.name: Live write proofs
gates.accept: all writers from certified action list and strict native receipt+fresh readback

gates.name: Outcome eligibility
gates.accept: only actual calendar-sim native or verified derived metrics, no hallucinated stats

gates.name: Causal scope
gates.accept: player/team/worldline independent unit preserved; interference and season trends reported

gates.name: Replicated/confirmatory round
gates.accept: weak signal must be confirmed in new preplanned sample; power/CI/FDR tracked

gates.name: Season decision-feedback loop
gates.accept: Human still controls sim, capture, plan seal, mutation, pause and next period
